title: Top-floor 3BHK with a private terrace
description: Corner flat on the top floor with a 200 sq ft terrace that catches the evening breeze off the Baner hill. Owner lives in Bangalore and is relaxed about pets and guests. The drive to Hinjewadi Phase 1 is the catch at peak hour.

title: Airy 3BHK in a low-rise near Baner Gaon
description: Four-storey building tucked behind the old village temple, so it's quiet after 9 pm. Big windows on both sides. Top floor with no lift and the rent is at the upper end for the lane.

title: Tidy 3BHK close to Baner metro
address: Sai Aangan, Baner Road, near Mahabaleshwar Hotel
description: Six minutes' walk to the Baner metro station with a supermarket on the ground floor. Only two bathrooms for three bedrooms. Society rules say no pets and the owner prefers vegetarian tenants.

title: Sunny 3BHK a walk from Balewadi High Street
description: East-facing, with a washing machine and ACs in all three bedrooms already fitted. Balewadi High Street's cafés are five minutes away. No balcony, and the building faces the main road.

title: Compact ground-floor 3BHK behind the stadium
address: Shree Ganesh Residency, Stadium Road, Lane 2
description: First-floor flat in a small four-storey building, so no lift is needed. Twelve minutes on foot to the Balewadi stadium metro. It's unfurnished and the rooms are on the smaller side.

title: Premium 3BHK in a gated Balewadi tower
description: Clubhouse, pool and a proper gym downstairs, fully furnished and ready to move in. Balconies off two bedrooms. Priced slightly above most Balewadi 3BHKs.

title: Older 3BHK in a walk-up near Balewadi Gaon
description: Good value for the area and the owner has just repainted. Top floor of a walk-up, so it's four flights with shopping bags. No power backup.

title: Spacious 3BHK off ITI Road
description: Quiet, leafy stretch of ITI Road with bakeries and D-Mart nearby. Fully furnished with good light. It's expensive, and the drive to Hinjewadi at peak hour is long.

title: Old-Aundh 3BHK with a big balcony
address: Sindh Society Row, Sindh Society, Lane 3
description: Top floor of a 1980s building in one of Aundh's calmest lanes, with a long balcony over mango trees. No lift. The owner lives on the ground floor.

title: 2BHK + study near Bremen Chowk
description: Ground-floor flat with a small sit-out garden, and the study is big enough for a single bed. Only two bathrooms. It faces the parking lot.

title: Leafy 3BHK off Pashan–Sus Road
description: Looks onto the Pashan hill, fully furnished with balconies off the living room and master bedroom. Sus Road gets you to Hinjewadi without the highway. The owner is vegetarian and doesn't allow pets.

title: Lovely 5th-floor walk-up with lake views
description: The prettiest flat on the list: a wraparound balcony over Pashan lake, fully furnished and well under budget. The catch is five floors of stairs and no lift.

title: Renovated 3BHK near NCL
description: Freshly renovated with a new modular kitchen and bathrooms, in a green, quiet campus-side lane. A little above what most of the group wants to spend.

title: Hill-view 3BHK in Bavdhan
description: Wide views of the NDA hills and cool evenings. Groceries mean a drive. Aundh is a 25-minute ride through Chandni Chowk traffic.

title: Budget 3BHK in an older Bavdhan society
description: Honest, cheap and a bit dated. Third floor, no lift, no backup, and the owner lives two doors down.

title: Corner 3BHK near Wakad Chowk
description: Fully furnished corner flat with cross-ventilation and a balcony off the living room. Fifteen minutes to Hinjewadi Phase 1. Only two bathrooms, and Wakad Chowk is loud at rush hour.

title: Large 3BHK in a gated Wakad township
description: Township with a pool, jogging track and weekend market. Three bathrooms and generous rooms. The owner wants a six-month deposit, which is steep.

title: Well-priced 3BHK behind Phoenix Mall
description: Good price, lift, three bathrooms. The society has car slots only, and two-wheelers have to go on the street outside.

title: 2BHK + study near Wakad bridge
description: The cheapest place on the list that would still work for three. The study is snug. Third floor with no lift.

title: Phase 1 3BHK walking distance to offices
description: Walk to the Phase 1 offices, with the metro station opening nearby. Huge township, so it can feel anonymous. Everything east of the highway is a long ride.

title: Phase 2 3BHK with clubhouse
description: Fully furnished with a riverside jogging track. Very good value. The trade is distance: Aundh and the city centre are 40+ minutes away.

title: 2BHK + study in Maan village
description: Very cheap, with fields out the back. Unfurnished, fourth floor, no lift, and you'd need a vehicle for everything.

title: Budget-friendly 3BHK in Pimple Saudagar
description: Quiet inner road with a vegetable market two minutes away, and three proper bathrooms. The owner is particular about late nights and guests. Aundh is 20 minutes across the bridge.

title: Roomy 3BHK near Shivar Chowk
description: Spacious rooms and a lively neighbourhood full of places to eat. Fourth floor of a walk-up.

title: New-build 3BHK in a gated complex
description: Brand new, never lived in, with a gym and play area. The broker is asking a ₹2L deposit, well above what the group planned for.

title: Within-budget 3BHK near Karishma Society
description: Sensible, well-kept and a ten-minute walk to the Kothrud metro. Everything a flat should be, but Aundh is a 30-minute cross-city ride and Hinjewadi is further.

title: Old-Kothrud 3BHK walk-up
description: Peaceful colony with big trees and good snacks at the corner shop. Top floor, no lift, and the owner downstairs prefers vegetarian tenants.

title: 3BHK by the Vanaz metro station
description: Three minutes from the Vanaz metro station, fully furnished and bright. Paud Road traffic noise reaches the front rooms.

title: Quiet 3BHK near Karve Nagar lake garden
description: Calm residential pocket near the canal garden, and very affordable. It's far from the west-side IT parks, and the owner locks the gate at 11 pm.

title: 2BHK + study in Karve Nagar
description: Fully furnished with a big study that could be a third bedroom. Only two bathrooms and no balcony.

title: Heritage bungalow-floor 3BHK in Deccan
description: Ground floor of a 1960s bungalow with high ceilings and a garden. Charming and central, and priced for it.

title: Central 3BHK near Deccan metro
description: Five minutes from the Deccan Gymkhana metro station, with FC Road on the doorstep. Noisy, no balcony, and far from the IT parks.

title: 3BHK above Shivajinagar metro
description: Model Colony address with metro, cafés and colleges all within a short walk. Well above budget for most groups.

title: Older 3BHK near Modern College
description: Central, cheap for the area and near the metro. It's a tired old building on a busy road, top floor with no lift.

title: Designer 3BHK in Koregaon Park Lane 6
address: The Banyan, Lane 6, North Main Road
description: Beautifully done up and shaded by huge rain trees, with every bedroom en-suite and air-conditioned. It costs almost double what the group planned.

title: Garden-facing 3BHK in KP Annexe
description: Overlooks a private garden, with pets welcome. Very expensive, and far from the west-side offices.

title: Ground-floor 3BHK in Lane 7
description: Cottage-style ground floor with a veranda. Only two bathrooms, and still very pricey.

title: Riverside 3BHK in Kalyani Nagar
description: River views and a short walk to the metro. Kavita's partner would love it. Everyone else's commute and budget would not.

title: Mid-size 3BHK near Kalyani Nagar metro
description: Well-connected, with good restaurants nearby. Expensive, and a long way from Hinjewadi and Aundh.

title: 3BHK near Phoenix Marketcity
description: Ready to move in, with the mall and airport minutes away. Over budget, and a 75-minute peak-hour drive from Hinjewadi.

title: Walk-up 3BHK in Viman Nagar
address: Datta Mandir CHS, Datta Mandir Chowk
description: Reasonable for Viman Nagar and close to Symbiosis. Top floor, no lift, two bathrooms.

title: Bright 3BHK off Airport Road
description: Well-maintained, but there's flight noise in the mornings. Too far east for anyone working in Hinjewadi.

title: 3BHK next to EON IT Park
address: Gera Greens, EON Free Zone Road
description: Township living next to EON, with plenty of food options. Great for East-Pune offices and awkward for everyone else.

title: Value 3BHK in Kharadi Bypass
description: A decent price for a lift building, but unfurnished, on the bypass, and only two bathrooms.

title: Magarpatta City 3BHK
description: Car-free internal roads, a big park and very safe. A long way from the west-side offices, gyms and family.

title: Budget 3BHK in Hadapsar
description: Very cheap, on the noisy Solapur Road. Fourth floor with no lift and no backup.

title: Green 3BHK near Wanowrie Bazaar
description: Leafy cantonment-side neighbourhood with a lovely weekly bazaar, and good value. Far from Aundh and Hinjewadi.

title: Furnished 3BHK near Salunke Vihar
address: Salunke Vihar Towers, Salunke Vihar Road
description: Fully furnished in a calm army-adjacent area. No pets, and it's the far side of the city from the west-side offices.
